data.title: Sprint 187 — Fresh Composition Coverage
data.focus: LOCKED and ready for fresh-session build under #1787–#1789. Six serial missions: binding repairs and fresh-input harness; naming/classification (5); ownership/summary (4); lifecycle/financial (5); discovery, eleven-row census disposition and delivery preparation; final proof/review handoff. Targets: 66/66 default public object/context schemas, 132/132 React+Vue generation cells, 28 named packed-consumer cells, 64 governed root IDs. Baseline: 27/66 and 58/132 at reviewed s186 source. Retain all 109 obligations under #1788; do not approve the old 98-runtime split. Authority: cmos/planning/forge-s187-fresh-composition-decision-memo.md; handoff: cmos/planning/forge-s187-build-handoff.md. Build tree /Users/systemsystems/.codex/worktrees/s187/OODS-Forge on codex/sprint-187-fresh-composition; canonical CMOS stays in the primary root. Build not started; s187-m01 is Current, remainder Queued. Separate review closes the sprint.

missions.name: Prove full fresh generation coverage and hand off for independent review
missions.objective: Verify the final 66-schema generation population and all 28 selected runtime cells, reconcile the evidence and public diff once, and leave a reviewable sprint without self-certification.

missions.name: Repair fresh composition bindings and extend the existing consumer harness
missions.objective: Make nine already-governed fresh schemas honor real component contracts, and let the existing packed-consumer runner consume authentic live object/context composition.

missions.name: Port naming and classification components into both governed roots
missions.objective: Implement LabelCell, InlineLabel, FormLabelGroup, ClassificationBadge, ClassificationEditor as real React and Vue families with documented HTML semantics and live fresh-composition consumer proof.

missions.name: Port ownership and summary components into both governed roots
missions.objective: Implement OwnerBadge, OwnershipSummary, OwnershipMeta, TagSummary as real React and Vue families with documented HTML semantics and live fresh-composition consumer proof.

missions.name: Port lifecycle and financial components into both governed roots
missions.objective: Implement ArchiveSummary, ArchivePill, CancellationForm, CancellationBadge, PriceCardMeta as real React and Vue families with documented HTML semantics and live fresh-composition consumer proof.

missions.name: Refresh discovery, reconcile census candidates and prepare delivery
missions.objective: Make current catalog claims surface-specific, disposition the eleven disputed census rows while retaining all 109 obligations, and prepare exact alias/adoption/deployment follow-through.
